sentences.text: The type species of this genus is Palmulasaurus quadratus, originally named Palmula quadratus.
It belongs to the family Polycotylidae.
This animal is the namesake of the subfamily Palmulasaurinae.
Only one fossil occurrence of Palmulasaurus has been recorded in the Paleobiology Database.
The genus name Palmula was renamed Palmulasaurus because it was already occupied by a different genus described in 1833.
Palmulasaurus lived during the Turonian stage, between 93.9 and 89.8 million years ago.
